slides.headline: Stop pasting the same prompt *every morning*
slides.sub: 5 minutes a day is 20 hours a year. Save it once as a skill instead.

slides.title: You retype the context
slides.body: The chat forgets your business every day. A skill remembers your rules, prices and tone.
slides.cost: Fix: write it once, load it every time

slides.title: Everyone has a version
slides.body: 4 people, 4 prompts, 4 different answers to the same customer.
slides.cost: Fix: 1 skill the whole team runs

slides.title: It lives in 1 head
slides.body: When that person is off, the process is off too.
slides.cost: Fix: the skill is the SOP, written down

slides.title: It's stuck in 1 tool
slides.body: Anthropic just gave skills to the Linux Foundation. 70+ AI tools read the same format.
slides.cost: Fix: build once, use it anywhere
